about: Every edit-screen box, the keys it stores and where each key is used. Read by aw_edit_screen_map() in includes/edit-screens.php. Short paths: core/ = plugins/animal-writes-core/includes/, seo/ = plugins/aw-seo-extras/includes/, src/ = plugins/aw-sourcing/includes/, kits/ = plugins/kits-core/includes/, acf-json/ = plugins/animal-writes-core/acf-json/. Line numbers are as of 1 Nov 2026. See docs/edit-screens.md.

submitdiv.title: Publish
submitdiv.notes: Sidebar panel in the block editor.

postimagediv.title: Featured image
postimagediv.notes: On Directory listings this is the logo.

postexcerpt.title: Excerpt
postexcerpt.notes: On Directory listings this is the short bio.

postcustom.title: Custom Fields
postcustom.notes: Block editor: only when switched on in Preferences → Panels. The only editor for aw_campaign_metrics, aw_legal_dated and aw_file_hi_url.

slugdiv.title: Slug
slugdiv.notes: Adds nothing on types without a public address (aw_press, aw_claim, aw_report, aw_message).

revisionsdiv.title: Revisions
revisionsdiv.notes: Shown only when the item has two or more revisions; stores nothing.

aw_related.title: Related
aw_related.notes: Rows depend on the type: aw_relations() in core/model.php.

aw_linked_from.title: Linked from
aw_linked_from.notes: Read-only list of items that point here; stores nothing.

aw-campaign-details.title: Campaign details
aw-campaign-details.notes: Same title as the SCF group "Campaign details"; both edit aw_campaign_close and aw_campaign_doc, and the SCF value is saved last.

aw-enrich-prov.title: Where these details come from
aw-enrich-prov.notes: Mostly read-only: the per-field sources also shown under each SCF field.

aw_org_people.title: Volunteers
aw_org_people.notes: Read-only list of FluentCRM contacts for this listing; needs edit_aw_volunteers.

aw_claim_review.title: Review
aw_claim_review.notes: Read-only claim details with Approve / Reject links.

acf-group_aw_campaign.title: Campaign details
acf-group_aw_campaign.notes: Duplicate edit with the side box "Campaign details" (aw_campaign_close, aw_campaign_doc); this value wins on save.

rank_math_metabox.title: Rank Math SEO
rank_math_metabox.notes: Sidebar in the block editor, a box on News (classic editor).

litespeed_meta_boxes.title: LiteSpeed
litespeed_meta_boxes.notes: No litespeed_* rows on live: adds nothing so far.

wpil_link-articles.title: Link Whisper Suggested Links
wpil_link-articles.notes: Rendering this box deletes wpil_links on that post (Link Whisper).
